evals.prompt: Create a Turnkey wallet for my agent that can hold both ETH and SOL. Use env vars TURNKEY_API_PUBLIC_KEY, TURNKEY_API_PRIVATE_KEY, and TURNKEY_ORGANIZATION_ID.
evals.expected_output: Working TypeScript code that initializes a Turnkey client, checks whether a wallet already exists (calls getWallets), and only creates a new wallet if none is found. The createWallet call should include both ADDRESS_FORMAT_ETHEREUM and ADDRESS_FORMAT_SOLANA accounts. Code logs both derived addresses.

evals.prompt: My agent already has a Turnkey org set up with a wallet. I just need the Ethereum address so I can start signing transactions.
evals.expected_output: Code that calls getWallets to find the existing wallet ID, then calls getWalletAccounts and filters for addressFormat === 'ADDRESS_FORMAT_ETHEREUM' to retrieve the address. Does NOT create a new wallet. Logs the ETH address.

evals.prompt: Bootstrap an agent wallet using Turnkey and print out all derived addresses.
evals.expected_output: Code that implements the full bootstrap flow: initialize client, list wallets, create one if none exists (deriving at minimum an ETH address), then print wallet ID and all account addresses. Should use @turnkey/sdk-server for automatic activity polling.
